## Aryan Island 1.1.0 — Liquid Glass Edition

**Developed by [aaryaninvincible](https://github.com/aaryaninvincible)**

### What's New in v1.1.0
- **Native RAM Cleaner & Auto-Memory Optimizer (`Boost RAM`)**:
  - One-click **Boost RAM** on the **System** page (click the **Memory** ring gauge, the **Clean RAM Now** chip, or the **Boost RAM** button in Top Processes), from the **Tools** quick tile (`Boost RAM`), or directly from the **System Tray (`Boost RAM`)**.
  - **Auto-Clean >85%**: Automatically trims background working sets when system memory exceeds 85% and drops a live Dynamic Island notification showing exact MB freed and before/after percentages.
  - **CPU / RAM Process Sorter**: Toggle the **Top Processes** table on the System page between CPU and Memory sorting with one click.
- **3 New Material Themes (`Cyber`, `Aurora`, `OLED`)**:
  - **Cyber**: Deep neon cyberpunk obsidian (`#070512`) with hyper-vivid neon accents and dual-tone cyan/magenta specular borders.
  - **Aurora**: Live Windows Composition backdrop blur combined with an animated starry night sky and emerald/violet borealis refraction.
  - **OLED**: Pitch-black `#000000` True AMOLED mode with razor-sharp luminous accent hairlines.
- **Mouse & Trackpad Gestures**:
  - **Edge Strip Scroll Volume Gesture**: Scroll the mouse wheel directly on the collapsed screen edge strip to adjust system volume and trigger the live Volume HUD pill without opening the panel.
  - **Two-Finger Touchpad Swipe / `Shift + Scroll` / Horizontal Drag**: Swipe horizontally with two fingers (`WM_MOUSEHWHEEL`), hold `Shift + Wheel`, or drag left/right anywhere on the open panel to glide between pages.
  - **Middle-Click Action Gesture**: Middle-click the collapsed strip or island pill to toggle **Play/Pause** (when media is active) or **Boost RAM** (when idle); middle-click inside the open panel to immediately run **Boost RAM**.
  - **Right-Click Collapsed Strip Gesture**: Right-click the collapsed bezel strip to open the panel directly to the **System & RAM Cleaner** page.

> [!NOTE]
> The executable is not code-signed yet, so Windows SmartScreen may show an "unknown publisher" warning the first time. Click **More info → Run anyway**.
